hero.subtitle: STAR CITIZEN MEETUP — May 9, 2026
hero.description: A special offline meetup for Star Citizen pilots. Share your experience in the 'verse and chat about the game together.

open.title: Register Now!
open.description: Limited to 100 people, first come first served! Don't miss out—complete your registration now.

closed.title: Registration Closed
closed.description: Thank you for your interest. Stay tuned for updates via our Discord community.

items.label: FEE
items.subtitle: Name tag, food and drinks included

items.title: Snack Time
items.description: A great way to start—pick and share food with the people at your table.

items.title: Information Exchange
items.description: Talk about the latest Star Citizen news and share tips with fellow pilots.

items.title: Networking
items.description: No more flying solo. Meet new friends through board games.

items.question: Can I attend without registering?
items.answer: Sorry. Due to space limitations, only registered attendees can participate.

items.question: Do I need to speak Korean?
items.answer: Most attendees are Korean speakers. For smooth communication and participation, you should be able to communicate in Korean.

items.question: Is there an age restriction?
items.answer: Anyone aged 19 or older can participate.

items.question: I can't eat certain foods.
items.answer: Sorry. We do not provide custom diets (vegetarian/halal) or allergen ingredient labeling for this event.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: We recommend public transportation. Parking may be unavailable due to limited space, and parking fees are not covered.

items.question: Can I cancel on-site?
items.answer: On-site cancellation is not possible. If you can't attend, please contact us via Discord. Refunds may not be available depending on the time period.

items.question: Will dinner be provided?
items.answer: Some food and drinks (including beer) will be provided. Please arrive on time on the day of the event!
